    Select responses for each dimension

    icc_cfa.Rd

    Select responses for each dimension

    icc_cfa(eta, gamma, lambda, psi)

    Arguments

    eta

    eta or ability

    gamma

    gamma or threshold

    lambda

    lambda or loading

    psi

    psi or error

    Examples

    icc_cfa(seq(-6,6,.1),1,1,1)
